Comprehensive reference for all exported functions and classes in RDesk.

## Scaffolding & Application Generation

### `rdesk_create_app()`
Generate a new, production-ready desktop dashboard scaffold.

```r
rdesk_create_app(name, path = tempdir(), theme = "light", open = TRUE)
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `name` | Character | *Mandatory* | Project and application folder name. |
| `path` | Character | `tempdir()` | Directory in which to create the project. |
| `theme` | Character | `"light"` | Visual theme: `"light"`, `"dark"`, or `"system"`. |
| `open` | Logical | `TRUE` | Whether to automatically open the generated project. |

## Core Application & Window Management

### `App` (R6 Class)
Primary controller managing the native window host and message routing loop.

```r
app <- App$new(title, width = 1200L, height = 800L, www = NULL, icon = NULL)
```

**Key Methods:**

* `app$on_message(event, callback)`: Register an event handler for messages from the UI.
* `app$send(event, payload)`: Dispatch a message to the frontend WebView2.
* `app$on_ready(callback)`: Hook triggered after the window is fully initialized.
* `app$set_menu(menu_list)`: Configure native application menu bar items.
* `app$toast(message, type)`: Trigger a native UI toast notification.
* `app$run()`: Start the blocking R event loop.
* `app$quit()`: Terminate the window and exit the application.

### `rdesk_is_bundle()`
Returns `TRUE` if currently running within a standalone packaged distribution stub.

```r
if (rdesk_is_bundle()) {
  # Production runtime logic
}
```

## Developer Velocity

### `rdesk_watch()`
Enables file system watcher for live hot-reloading during development.

```r
rdesk_watch(app)
```

---

## Asynchronous Background Tasks

### `async()`
Wraps a handler function to execute in a non-blocking background worker.

```r
app$on_message("calculate", async(function(payload) { ... }, app = app))
```

### `async_progress()`
Wraps a multi-step worker function with live progress streaming.

```r
app$on_message("export", async_progress(function(payload, update_progress) { ... }, app = app))
```

### `rdesk_jobs_list()` / `rdesk_cancel_job()`
Manage active background tasks.

---

## Persistent Storage

### `rdesk_storage()`
Initialize or retrieve a JSON-backed storage container.

```r
store <- rdesk_storage(app_name, scope = c("user", "system"))
```

* `store$get(key, default = NULL)`: Read a stored key.
* `store$set(key, value)`: Write a value atomically.
* `store$delete(key)`: Remove a key.
* `store$clear()`: Clear all stored values.
* `store$keys()`: List all keys.

---

## Bundling & Packaging

### `build_app()`
Package an R application into a standalone Windows `.zip` archive or setup installer.

```r
build_app(
  app_dir,
  app_name = NULL,
  version = "1.0.0",
  out_dir = "dist",
  portable_r_method = "installer",
  build_installer = FALSE,
  overwrite = FALSE
)
```

---

## Serialisation & Data Utilities

### `rdesk_df_to_list()`
Converts an R `data.frame` into a list structure optimized for tabular JavaScript rendering (`cols` and `rows`).

### `rdesk_plot_to_base64()`
Converts any ggplot2, lattice, or base graphics plot into a base64-encoded PNG data URI string ready for embedding into HTML `<img>` tags.
